title: Frequency of reporting of credit information by Credit Institutions to Credit Information Companies

obligations.text: Credit institutions must keep the credit information collected or maintained by them updated regularly on a monthly basis or at such shorter intervals as mutually agreed upon between the CI and the CIC.
obligations.applies_to: Credit Institutions (CIs) and Credit Information Companies (CICs)
obligations.quote: directing the credit information companies (CICs) and credit institutions (CIs) to keep the credit information collected/maintained by them updated regularly on a monthly basis or at such shorter intervals as mutually agreed upon

obligations.text: CICs and CIs shall keep the credit information collected or maintained by them updated regularly on a fortnightly basis (as on 15th and last day of the respective month) or at such shorter intervals as mutually agreed upon between the CI and the CIC.
obligations.quote: CICs and CIs shall keep the credit information collected/maintained by them updated regularly on a fortnightly basis (i.e., as on 15th and last day of the respective month) or at such shorter intervals as mutually agreed upon between the CI and the CIC.

obligations.text: CIs shall ensure the fortnightly submission of credit information to CICs within seven (7) calendar days of the relevant reporting fortnight.
obligations.deadline: Within seven (7) calendar days of the relevant reporting fortnight
obligations.quote: The fortnightly submission of credit information by CIs to CICs shall be ensured within seven (7) calendar days of the relevant reporting fortnight.

obligations.text: CICs shall ingest credit information data received from CIs, as per their data acceptance rules, within five (5) calendar days of its receipt from the CIs.
obligations.deadline: Within five (5) calendar days of receipt from the CIs
obligations.quote: CICs are required to ingest credit information data received from the CIs, as per their data acceptance rules, within seven (7) calendar days of its receipt from the CIs. This is now being revised to five (5) calendar days of its receipt.

obligations.text: CICs shall provide a list of CIs which are not adhering to the fortnightly data submission timelines to the Department of Supervision, Reserve Bank of India, Central Office at half yearly intervals.
obligations.deadline: Half yearly, as on March 31 and September 30 each year
obligations.quote: CICs shall provide a list of CIs which are not adhering to the fortnightly data submission timelines to Department of Supervision, Reserve Bank of India, Central Office at half yearly intervals (as on March 31 and September 30 each year) for information and monitoring purposes.

obligations.text: CICs and CIs must adhere to the above directions, and those that contravene or default in adherence are liable for penal action under the provisions of CICRA, 2005.
obligations.quote: CICs and CIs that contravene or default in adherence to the above directions shall be liable for penal action as per the provisions of CICRA, 2005.

ratings.policy_quote: Credit information for all borrowers is submitted to the CICs once a month, within 7 days of the month end.
ratings.finding: FC-15 §2.1 requires monthly submission of credit information for all borrowers to the CICs, and FC-15 §1.1 confirms FlexiCredit reports to all four CICs, which meets the obligation to keep credit information updated monthly.

ratings.policy_quote: Credit information for all borrowers is submitted to the CICs once a month, within 7 days of the month end.
ratings.finding: The policy updates borrower credit information to CICs only once a month, whereas the rule requires fortnightly updates as on the 15th and last day of each month or a shorter agreed interval.
ratings.action: Change FC-15 §2.1 so that credit information is updated and submitted to all four CICs fortnightly, as on the 15th and last day of each month.

ratings.policy_quote: Credit information for all borrowers is submitted to the CICs once a month, within 7 days of the month end.
ratings.finding: The policy submits data monthly within 7 days of month end rather than fortnightly within 7 days of each reporting fortnight, so the submission frequency falls short of the rule.
ratings.action: Amend FC-15 §2.1 to require fortnightly submission to CICs within seven calendar days of each reporting fortnight.
